# PUA ICPC

> Community website for the ICPC training program at Pharos University in
> Alexandria: training plan, events calendar, cadet leaderboard, registration,
> committee recruitment specs, referral bounties and a feedback bucket.
> Built with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Cloud Firestore and
> Supabase.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/README.md): what the project is, quick start, commands and testing
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, verification commands and the PR flow
- [Architecture overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/docs/architecture/overview.md): routes, data flows and backend fallbacks
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/docs/configuration.md): environment variables, defaults and fallbacks
- [Data model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/docs/data-model.md): Firestore collections, Supabase tables and browser storage
- [Dependency graph](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/docs/architecture/dependency-graph.md): component import tree
- [Design system](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/DESIGN.md): tokens, typography and visual rules
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/SECURITY.md): how to report vulnerabilities
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AhmedNasser-bug/icpcpua/main/CHANGELOG.md): notable changes
